clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Deino calls promising Horde mages to aid their craft. The troll mage works from the Valley of Spirits and seeks an adept for important work. Her summons opens a path to deeper study and duties across Kalimdor.

Horde mages hone their arcane abilities under the guidance of instructors. When a student is ready for harder work, mentors such as Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity point the way to Orgrimmar. In its troll quarter, specialized knowledge and dangerous work await.

Deino lives in Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Among the Darkspear, few study arcane magic compared with the many witch doctors and priests, which makes Deino an authority in the capital. Her work serves Horde mages beyond local concerns, and she seeks ambitious spellcasters willing to face dangers far from home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, friend. She resides in Orgrimmar, in the Darkbriar Lodge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, you have come. My task is not an easy one, but vital to the society of mages. If you aid me, I am sure you will find it worthwhile.
